summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub (oven-sh/bun release v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable, and execFileSync's it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob using a string-array rotation decoder (`array.push(array.shift())` shuffle plus large numeric/character lookup table and obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers). The published `main` module is a trivial 3-line 'Hello ${name}!' stub, so the declared purpose of the package does not require pulling a second language runtime or executing a large obfuscated payload at install. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to run an obfuscated sibling under it — rather than executing the shipped code with the already-present Node — is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern and bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners; the payload runs with the installer's privileges on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
